items.title: Father Al Lewis Interview, 1972-02-21
items.q: Buddy Charles went back there with him too, playing guitar.

ctx.x: And Buddy Charles, it was downstairs. Buddy Charles went back there with him too, playing guitar. When guitarists came out of the lake, we were on that guitar. He was playing back there, Buddy Charles was playing back there. It was Henry Harden's band. And Buddy Charles, Henry Harden, and one of his brothers there, John Casimir. William Casimir was playing with him. So actually the phone player that was?
